ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: From the above food web diagram, what happens to the grasshopper if all the grasses died out?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, “Grasshopper” can be seen located in the lower middle-right position, and “Grasses” is located in the bottom right position. There is an arrow from “Grasses” pointing to “Grasshopper”, indicating that grass provides food or energy for the grasshopper. Reasoning: If all the grass dies, the grasshopper's food source disappears. According to food web rules, organisms that depend on that food source will be unable to survive. Therefore, grasshopper dies.
